meta.scope: online research only; no mod code, no gradle, no git; MIT clean-room, only public formulas/parameter names/architecture recorded, no GPL source text copied

target_mod_context.problem: current thrust applied along body-forward instead of body-up; roll has no physical effect
target_mod_context.fix_pitch: thrust along bodyUp=attitude*(0,1,0); hoverThrottle=mg/T_max; tilt -> g*tan(tilt) horizontal accel, T*cos(tilt) vertical component

lineage.name: Butterflight
lineage.note: forked after BF 3.3 removed Kalman filter

lineage.name: EmuFlight
lineage.author: Marinus
lineage.note: based on open-sourced HelioRC IMUF; name voted by community; blue bird logo; feature ABG(alpha-beta-gamma) predictive filter

renaming.verdict: EmuFlight is a real open-source flight controller, descendant of Cleanflight->Betaflight->Butterflight; not a separate lineage
renaming.cleanflight_status: common upstream of Betaflight / INAV / EmuFlight, not the garbled one

physics.thrust_direction: along body +Z (body-up, propellers facing up), NOT along body forward

equations.meaning: to hold altitude while pitched theta, total thrust must grow
horizontal acceleration from tilt; same for roll giving lateral accel
vertical thrust component shrinks when tilted -> altitude drops if thrust magnitude unchanged
hover throttle is the command where total thrust equals weight

equations.note: coefficient k to be tuned per airframe; textbook simplification m*vz_dot = F*cos(theta) - b*vz - m*g

tilt_effects.pitch_down: accelerate forward; slight altitude loss because vertical component shrinks
tilt_effects.roll: lateral acceleration; altitude loss; NOT purely visual

hover_throttle_parameters.behavior: AltHold starts at hover_throttle, PID trims around it; too low drops, too high climbs

hover_throttle_parameters.curve_param: MPC_THR_CURVE=Rescale to hover thrust by default
hover_throttle_parameters.note: racers / camera drones may drop to ~0.35
read OSD hover throttle value; if >1700 PWM motors underpowered

fixed_wing.mechanism: ailerons bank the wing; lift vector tilted gives centripetal force; rudder removes adverse yaw / sideslip so balance ball centers
fixed_wing.inav: TURN ASSIST auto-applies elevator+rudder in RTH/LOITER/CRUISE/WP

multirotor.how_it_turns: roll tilt produces lateral force (g*tan(phi)); yaw changes heading independently

coordinated_turn.mod_p_b_2_note: mod's 'coordinated turn' on vanilla remote server is a LOOK-MAPPING (roll amount -> equivalent yaw delta, optional pitch compensation), NOT real aerodynamic coordinated turn; GUI must label it as compatibility-layer approximation

quadx_motor_map_props_out.warning: Props-In / Butterflight style mirrors this; trust Configurator Motors tab diagram

default_rates_4_3_plus.note: user-stated center70/max670/expo0 confirmed; roll and pitch defaults must stay equal

airmode.meaning: 姿态控制在低油门仍输出, prevent flipping when throttle cut

emuflight.origin: fork of Butterflight (itself a BF fork), summer 2019, by Marinus, after open-sourcing HelioRC IMUF
emuflight.signature_filter: ABG (alpha-beta-gamma) predictive filter on gyro/d-term; params ABG_Alpha (strength), ABG_Boost (reaction to fast changes)
emuflight.mod_relevance: none for client-side motion sim; kept for naming clarification only

px4_and_ardupilot_extra.geometric_controller: T = m * ||a_des + g*z_hat||; body z = (a_des + g*z_hat)/||.||
px4_and_ardupilot_extra.px4_stabilized: roll/pitch sticks control attitude angle, not rate; self-level on release
px4_and_ardupilot_extra.px4_thrust_curve: THR_MDL_FAC ~0.3 for PWM ESCs compensating non-linear throttle->thrust (~quadratic)

mod_mapping.effect: low throttle still does roll/pitch control

mod_mapping.task: P-B-1 remote: write attitude->yaw/pitch back to look

mod_mapping.effect: gain configurable, default on, label as approximation

mod_mapping.basis: vanilla elytra has no propulsion; direction follows written-back look
